"""BEHAVIOR-1K tidying_bedroom live-session helper and trajectory index.

The episode was controlled through a single persistent rcb_client session.
This file intentionally does not create a new Robot() connection on import or
when run: the service provides one client/episode, and the saved runs contain
the actual camera/proprio recordings from that session.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Sequence

import numpy as np


CAM_LEFT = "robot_r1:left_realsense_link:Camera:0"
CAM_RIGHT = "robot_r1:right_realsense_link:Camera:0"
CAM_HEAD = "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0"


def ee_targets(obs: Any) -> tuple[list[float], list[float]]:
    """Return observed left/right end-effector poses in world XYZW order."""
    now = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
    return list(now[35:42]), list(now[42:49])


def submit_ee(
    robot: Any,
    left: Sequence[float],
    right: Sequence[float],
    *,
    left_gripper: float = 1.0,
    right_gripper: float = 1.0,
    note: str = "ee_pose",
) -> Any:
    """Submit one two-arm EE target row (gripper 1=open, 0=closed)."""
    row = np.asarray(
        [*left[:7], left_gripper, *right[:7], right_gripper], dtype=np.float32
    )[None, :]
    return robot.submit("ee_pose", row, video="frames", note=note)


def save_result(result: Any, label: str, runs_dir: str = "/app/runs") -> Path:
    """Save an action result using a unique numbered run directory."""
    root = Path(runs_dir)
    existing = [p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and p.name[:3].isdigit()]
    out = root / f"{max((int(p.name[:3]) for p in existing), default=-1) + 1:03d}_{label}"
    result.save(str(out))
    return out


# Recorded live-session checkpoints, in execution order. Each directory holds
# the result metadata, camera frames/video, and proprioception for that action.
TRAJECTORY_RUNS = [
    "000_init2",
    "006_book_pregrasp",
    "032_book_edge_grasp",
    "102_sandal1_exact2",
    "110_sandal1_raise_before_drive",
    "119_restore_stable_arm_targets",

    "153_scan_turn_small",
    "157_scan_turn_bedside",
    "163_retreat_restore_stable",
    "166_book_reach_repeat_calib",
    "181_restore_trunk_arm_q2_24",
    "185_book_reach_repeat2",
    "188_book_wrist_image_center",
    "193_self_right_stable_posture",
    "199_sandal2_center_increment2",
    "208_sandal2_lower_contact",
    "210_sandal2_pixel_center_increment",
]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Live episode trajectory recordings are stored in /app/runs.")
    print(f"Recorded checkpoints: {len(TRAJECTORY_RUNS)}")
